newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 15.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Aug 15.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average ended up 13.71 points at 7,942.03.
* Indonesian overnight money jumped to 125 percent on Friday from 50.0/60.0 percent in early trade on extremely tight liquidity, dealers said.

* Indonesian central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono said on Thursday that the bank's decision to abandon its intervention band was taken because other countries in the region had floated their currencies.
* On Thursday, the Jakarta composite index closed down 15.59 points, or 2.37 percent, at 643.01 points on an announcement by the central bank that it was scrapping its intervention band.
* The Indonesian rupiah was quoted at 2,775.00/95.00 against the dollar at 0200 GMT compared with 2,770.00/90.00 at the opening.
* Banks, particularly small banks including Unibank, Bank Servitia and Bank Pikko, as they may be hit by the higher cost of funds because of high overnight call money rates.
* Other banks, including Bank International Indonesia and Bank Negara Indonesia as the abolishment of the central bank's intervention band could hit earnings from foreign exchange activities.
* Cigarette maker Gudang Garam, BDNI and Astra following announcements of first half net profits.
* Telecommunications firm Telkom and Indosat on a Neraca newspaper report that the government did not plan to hike telephone fees despite the rupiah's depreciation against the dollar.
